title: Block Duplicate Leads in Zoho CRM Automatically (No Code) #Shorts
description:
Stop duplicate leads from cluttering your CRM database. Learn how to enable native duplicate handling on the Email field in Zoho CRM in under a minute.

1. Go to Setup › Customization › Modules and Fields
2. Select Leads › Duplicate Handling
3. Set 'Email' as the unique field to prevent duplicates

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.

angle.problem: Duplicate leads cluttering the database from web forms.
angle.solution: Enable 'Duplicate Handling' in the Lead module settings.
steps: Go to Setup > Customization > Modules and Fields
Set 'Email' as the unique field to prevent duplicates
angle.result: Clean database with zero duplicate lead entries.

lines.say: Duplicate leads ruining your sales team's productivity?

lines.say: Web forms constantly create double entries that confuse reps and waste valuable follow-up time.

lines.say: You can block duplicate leads automatically inside Zoho CRM without writing custom code.

lines.say: First, click the top gear icon to open Setup, go to Customization, and select Modules and Fields.
lines.tts: First, click the top gear icon to open Setup, go to Customization, and select Modules and Fields.

lines.say: Next, locate the Leads module, click the three-dot menu icon, and choose Duplicate Handling.
lines.tts: Next, locate the Leads module, click the three-dot menu icon, and choose Duplicate Handling.

lines.say: Now, check the option for unique fields and set Email as your main unique identifier.

lines.say: Finally, choose to prevent duplicate records and click Save to lock in your settings.
lines.tts: Finally, choose to prevent duplicate records and click Save to lock in your settings.

lines.say: Your database stays clean with zero duplicates. Set it up once and you are done.

test_before_recording: Ensure you have Administrator access in your Zoho CRM instance.
Check that the Email field in the Leads module does not already contain duplicate values.
